theme_and_archetype.reasoning: The application requires a dark blue sports theme combining the high-energy command-center precision of 'Performance Pro' with the premium, exclusive 'Luxury' feel for VIP members.

rules.cta: Use primary accent (#C4FF00) for VIP unlock and main conversion buttons ONLY. Text on these buttons MUST be black (#000000) for contrast.
rules.backgrounds: Never use pure #000000. Always tint dark backgrounds with deep navy.
rules.glassmorphism: For sticky headers, use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-[#0B1021]/70 and a 1px border-white/10.

rules.anti_default: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans-serif for headings.
rules.data_display: Use JetBrains Mono for odds and prediction numbers (e.g., 2.50, 1X) to ensure perfect vertical alignment.

spacing_and_layout.system: Generous Spacing Philosophy - use 2x standard padding.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: For VIP features, use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 or gap-8. Mix tall (span-row-2) and wide (span-col-2) cards.
spacing_and_layout.data_density: For the Fixed Odds section, use the 'Control Room' dense grid approach. Tighter gaps (gap-4) and tabular layouts.

rules.cards: Any card with a border must have at least p-6 padding.
rules.alignment: Left-align dense text and prediction data. Center-align hero text only if it serves the impact.

header.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B1021]/80 border-b border-white/10

cards.classes: bg-[#131B2F] border border-white/10 rounded-xl relative overflow-hidden

premium_card.classes: relative bg-[#1A243D] border border-[#C4FF00]/30 rounded-xl shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(196,255,0,0.1)]

buttons.primary: bg-[#C4FF00] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide rounded-lg px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#AEE600] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-white/20 text-white font-semibold rounded-lg px-8 py-4 hover:border-white/50 transition-colors

shadcn_customization.general: Strip 'Vercel-look' from Shadcn components. Increase border radius slightly to 12px (rounded-xl) for main cards.
shadcn_customization.tables: For Fixed Odds and Results. Use border-collapse with subtle border-b border-white/5 for rows.

motion_and_interaction.hero: Subtle scale up on background image, staggered fade-in up for text elements (H1, Subtitle, CTA).
motion_and_interaction.cards: Hover states must elevate (-translate-y-1) and increase border opacity.
motion_and_interaction.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for a 'Recent Winners' or 'Live Matches' ticker below the hero. Style: text-sm font-mono tracking-widest bg-[#C4FF00] text-black py-2.

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Duotone for large decorative icons, Regular for UI elements.
icons_and_assets.whatsapp_button: Fixed bottom-right corner. Use a glowing effect (shadow-lg shadow-green-500/50). bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full z-50 hover:scale-110 transition-transform.

hero_background.description: Dark blue cinematic football stadium at night. Use as full-screen background with bg-[#0B1021]/70 overlay.

vip_concept.description: Abstract glowing football sphere with neon accents. Use for the Premium Predictions section background or side graphic.

vip_pass.description: Premium gold and navy blue VIP pass. Use inside the 'Unlock VIP Games' payment CTA card.

homepage.hero: Full height (min-h-[90vh]). Centered heavy typography. Background: hero_background with heavy dark overlay to ensure text contrast.
homepage.vip_games: Bento grid layout. Locked state visually obscured with a blur filter (backdrop-blur-sm) and a centered Lock icon.
homepage.premium_predictions: High-contrast section. Use vip_concept as a subtle watermark background.
homepage.fixed_odds: Tabular format using 'Control Room' grid. Show match details, odds numbers in monospace, and a clear bet/copy action.
homepage.results: Minimalist list view. Green for WINS, Red for LOSSES. Data-heavy but spacious.
homepage.footer: Dark background, solid structure. Social links prominent.

auth_pages.layout: Split screen. Left side: form with minimal borders. Right side: hero_background with a large brand statement.

dashboard_admin.layout: Sidebar navigation. Dense data tables for managing games and users. Strict grid hierarchy.

technical_requirements.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='vip-unlock-btn', data-testid='login-submit').
technical_requirements.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios for text over images. Focus states must be highly visible (ring-2 ring-[#C4FF00]).
technical_requirements.payment: Implement Paystack flow clearly. After successful payment, the 'Locked' UI for VIP games transitions to unlocked.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion react-fast-marquee @studio-freight/lenis
Update Tailwind config to include Outfit, Manrope, and JetBrains Mono fonts.
Implement the Hero section using the provided hero_background image.
Build the Fixed Odds and VIP sections with the exact color hex codes provided (base #0B1021, surface #131B2F, primary #C4FF00).
Ensure the floating WhatsApp button is absolutely positioned and has a high z-index.
Do NOT use placeholder images. Rely exclusively on the media URLs provided in this JSON.
Follow the specific typography scales—never use text-7xl or above for the hero.
